items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: "You recorded with me." ... "Then Lainie Kazan, Body and Soul."

ctx.x: Yeah, but that was – that’s one of the ones I think that kind of skirted out underneath the wire for most people, because Herbie was really doing Rocket and all that kind of stuff. It was another period for Herbie. Then a couple ones with Harvey Mason – one session with Harvey. Then Lainie Kazan, Body and Soul.

She told me I did – I saw her at the Skirball. She walked up to me, say, “I’m Lainie Kazan.” I didn’t remember who’s that. Then she said, “You recorded with me.” So I got a copy of it. Lainie Kazan, yeah. Then I listened to it, actually, after that.
Diane Reeves, Harvey Mason again, Joe Sample – dapper Joe.
